notes.title: MacOs versions will be added 26th of April, 2019
notes.content:
We happy to say, MacOs version will be added 26th of April, 2019. Supported languages:
- English
- French
- German
- Italian
- Spanish
- Dutch
- Portuguese

tags.feature: - A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.
- Added three new playable heroes: Queen of Pain, Slark, and Templar Assassin
